description: Step 1 of uploading a video or image you hold (up to 200MB video / 25MB image) into the user's oriiion account — no API key and no browser needed. Returns a presigned PUT: send the raw file bytes (not multipart, not base64) to upload.url with exactly upload.headers, before upload.expiresAt (30 minutes), body at most sizeBytes. Then call finalize_media_upload with the mediaId. Allowed contentType: video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/webm, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif. Output: { mediaId, status: 'pending', upload: { method: 'PUT', url, headers, expiresAt, maxBytes }, kind, contentType, filename }.

contentType.description: MIME type of the file: video/mp4, video/quicktime, video/webm, image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif

filename.description: Original filename, e.g. 'launch.mp4'. The stored extension always follows contentType.

sizeBytes.description: Exact file size in bytes; the upload is refused if the body is larger

name: create_media_upload_url

expiresAt.description: ISO time after which the PUT is refused

title: Create Media Upload URL (large files)
